author: Contributor 100
about: The pinned worker’s published rules, with a real registered Clerk public client and consent-issued PKCE code. The worker forwards provider status and body unchanged; successful exchange is recorded as 200, while a separately configured throwing fetch is recorded as 502. Client/verifier/callback bindings, expiry, invitation delivery and source refusals remain exercised. The proxy source rules preserve all eight methods, opaque body bytes, query parameters, cookies and manual redirects; every proxy response overwrites the four Worker hardening headers.
